question: How should CARE use the newer HUMAN PORT object aperture without becoming a file store, messaging system or admission authority?

recovered_state.care: CARE 0.4 already owned episode observation, care course, clinician/vet brief, BODY/CONTINUITY conversion and direct CONTACT handoff.
recovered_state.port: HUMAN PORT 1.5 already owned addressed TEXT/JSON/IMAGE/FILE passage, exact byte hash/local stash, focus, FIT/CUES/HISTORY and candidate-only FIELD INTAKE routing.
recovered_state.body: BODY / FIELD 0.2 already owned low-burden NOW/PULSE/TEST embodied returns and explicit BODY -> CARE offer.
recovered_state.intake: FIELD INTAKE 0.5 already owned reviewed durable admission of Port objects.

blindspots_closed: CARE declared private image/file attachments as a gap even though Port already had the appropriate private local byte substrate.
CARE bypassed Port object identity/focus and jumped directly to CONTACT, losing lawful alternate routes for the same case.
CARE evidence refs lacked a return path back to the addressed source object.
CARE direct consult used REPLY even when the case had an explicit ASK.
delta: CARE PORT CASE emits an exact SHA-256 JSON snapshot as human-port-object/v0.1 with case id/revision retained in provenance.
Port gains ADD TO CARE for TEXT/JSON/IMAGE/FILE; it sends identity/hash/provenance/scope/focus as an offer only.
CARE requires explicit ATTACH TO CURRENT CASE and stores a care-evidence-ref/v0.1 reference rather than duplicating file/image bytes.
CARE FOLLOW/BRIEF expose evidence references and OPEN SOURCE returns addressable sources to Port.
CONTACT BRIEF uses NEED when CARE ASK is non-empty, otherwise REPLY.
FIELD now marks CARE PRIVATE_FILES AVAILABLE through Port rather than maintaining stale adapter debt.

authority_split.port: source-object passage, local byte retention, focus and route selection
authority_split.care: care-context attachment, longitudinal interpretation boundary and consult compression

laws: PORT OBJECT != CARE EVIDENCE until explicit attach
EVIDENCE REFERENCE MUST RETAIN SOURCE RETURN WHEN AVAILABLE
nonclaims: No OCR, diagnosis, triage or automatic interpretation was added.
CARE does not own or duplicate HUMAN PORT local file/image bytes.
A Port route cue does not imply medical relevance or authority.
A source reference may become non-durable if it was session-only; CARE surfaces this rather than pretending persistence.
next_evidence: ordinary use with one real eye photo/report or other care artifact through Port -> CARE -> OPEN SOURCE
ordinary use of one CARE case through PORT CASE, focus BRIEF or ASK, then choose CONTACT versus FIELD INTAKE
observe whether multi-object evidence bundles are actually needed before designing them
stop_condition: Do not add bundles, new media classes, adaptive clinical question engines or automated care routing until ordinary use exposes a repeated deficit.
